config.install: git clone at the pinned commit, scripts/brain.py imported
config.unit: one Concept per note (title = note id)
config.query: every question word quoted, OR-joined (raw questions are an FTS5 syntax error)
config.answer: extractive: best-overlap sentence of top-3 notes
config.abstain: no hit, or no sentence shares a content word

notes: Run from a clone at a pinned commit (not on PyPI). Raw questions are an FTS5 syntax error in SecondBrain.search(), so the adapter quotes and OR-joins the words. Pure FTS5 ranking, no entity check: answers all 22 absent questions.
